metadata.verificationNote: All 55 findings re-verified against the working tree on 2026-07-02 (gates + per-finding code inspection). Remaining "open" items were confirmed not-yet-addressed. Env caveats: build needs pnpm install for a new @fontsource dep; 4 pi-runtime server test files (21 tests) require rg/git binaries absent in this sandbox (see QA-0014).

findings.summary: Main-source lint fails on a no-unused-expressions violation.
findings.evidence: ESLint reports @typescript-eslint/no-unused-expressions at line 85.
findings.recommendation: Replace the side-effect-only ternary with an explicit if/else branch.

findings.summary: Root build and test scripts are not reproducible when bare pnpm is absent from PATH.
findings.evidence: Root build/test invoke scripts/with-project-node.sh pnpm ..., which fails with 'exec: pnpm: not found'.
findings.recommendation: Use a reproducible pnpm invocation such as corepack pnpm in nested scripts, or ensure the wrapper exposes pnpm consistently.

findings.summary: Desktop build script invokes bare pnpm internally.
findings.evidence: Workspace build fails at @zclaudia/desktop build with 'sh: pnpm: command not found'.
findings.recommendation: Use corepack pnpm or avoid invoking pnpm from inside the package build script.

findings.summary: Desktop test runner spawns bare pnpm and fails without useful diagnostics.
findings.evidence: desktop test exits with status 1 and no child-process error details in the inherited output.
findings.recommendation: Spawn corepack pnpm or resolve pnpm through the project wrapper, and print result.error when spawnSync fails.

findings.summary: Formatting gate fails across most of the repository.
findings.evidence: prettier --list-different reports 1689 main-source/script files: server 888, desktop 680, shared 60, e2e 50, scripts 11.
findings.recommendation: Run one mechanical formatting change after deciding whether to include generated/local-only files, then enforce format:check.

findings.summary: Root lint scans ignored local worktree directories.
findings.evidence: Root eslint . reports an additional error under .claire/worktrees even though .claire/ and .claude/ are gitignored.
findings.recommendation: Add top-level .claude/ and .claire/ ignores to the ESLint flat config.

findings.summary: Domain route issues raw SQL directly.
findings.evidence: Architecture check flags db.prepare calls in a domain route.
findings.recommendation: Move persistence and schema probing behind a repository or service boundary.

findings.summary: Domain route validates LLM profiles with direct SQL.
findings.evidence: Architecture check flags db.prepare calls in agent profile routes.
findings.recommendation: Move LLM profile existence checks into a repository/service API.

findings.summary: Desktop utility reads selectedSessionId from projectStore instead of selectionStore.
findings.evidence: Architecture check flags projectStore selectedSessionId reads at lines 23, 72, and 112.
findings.recommendation: Read selection state through selectionStore and keep projectStore focused on project/session data.

findings.summary: Shared component imports a feature module.
findings.evidence: Architecture check flags an import from ../features/git/store.
findings.recommendation: Move the dependency to the owning feature, pass data through props, or move shared logic to a neutral layer.

findings.summary: Lint warning volume reduces signal quality.
findings.evidence: Main-source lint reports 2423 warnings, led by 1253 non-null assertions and 372 explicit any usages.
findings.recommendation: Create focused warning-reduction tracks and avoid making all warnings blockers until the backlog is reduced.
findings.verificationNote: Warnings reduced 2423 -> 772 on 2026-07-02; remaining are non-blocking backlog.

findings.summary: Desktop build emits large chunks.
findings.evidence: Vite warns about feature-interactive around 1506 kB and index around 809 kB after minification.
findings.recommendation: Review code splitting after quality gates are reliable, starting with feature-interactive and index.
findings.verificationNote: manualChunks added in vite.config.ts; feature-interactive chunk still ~2628kB (bundles chat/fileviewer/supervision).

findings.summary: A dynamic import is ineffective because the same module is statically imported elsewhere.
findings.evidence: Vite reports src/services/api/base.ts is dynamically imported by servers.ts but also statically imported by several modules.
findings.recommendation: Either remove the dynamic import or isolate the lazy-loaded dependency so the chunk split is effective.
findings.verificationNote: Dynamic import removed; base.ts is now statically imported only, so the ineffective-split no longer applies.

findings.summary: Server tests have environment assumptions that fail under restricted sandboxing.
findings.evidence: Sandboxed run fails on listen EPERM and writes under ~/.zclaudia/workspace/skills; non-sandbox run passes 4845 tests with 1 skipped.
findings.recommendation: Document the required test environment or make affected tests use injectable temp dirs and socket-free request paths where possible.
findings.verificationNote: vitest.config now conditionally excludes socket-bound tests when loopback unavailable; tests still require rg/git binaries.

findings.summary: Server Vitest config uses a deprecated Vitest 4 option.
findings.evidence: Vitest reports test.poolOptions was removed in Vitest 4 and previous poolOptions are now top-level options.
findings.recommendation: Update the Vitest configuration to the current Vitest 4 schema.

findings.summary: Shared package has formatting drift.
findings.evidence: Prettier reports 60 files under shared/src as not matching project style.
findings.recommendation: Normalize shared formatting as part of the repository-wide mechanical format pass.

findings.summary: Root shared entrypoint re-exports UI-facing facade APIs.
findings.evidence: shared/src/index.ts re-exports facade/index.ts, while 283 consumer files import from @zclaudia/shared directly.
findings.recommendation: Keep root imports for compatibility, but document subpath imports as canonical and avoid exposing UI facade APIs through server-facing root imports.
findings.verificationNote: index.ts comment marks subpath imports as canonical (legacy root), but root still re-exports facade/index.js.

findings.summary: Root entrypoint is not a complete representation of package exports.
findings.evidence: package.json exposes broad subpath exports, while root index omits modules such as core/agent-readiness, core/provider-policy, features/executor, features/spec-change, and features/meta-workflow.
findings.recommendation: Document root as a legacy convenience surface and use subpath exports as the canonical contract boundary.
findings.verificationNote: Root documents "prefer sub-path imports" and includes subpath modules; still a convenience surface rather than a formal deprecation.

findings.summary: Wire message unions are manually maintained.
findings.evidence: ClientMessage and ServerMessage are hand-built unions; current shared tests only prove a small subset of messages flow through the union.
findings.recommendation: Add compile-time coverage per wire message module or restructure unions so new message types are included closer to their definition.
findings.verificationNote: union-coverage.test.ts now asserts mutual assignability between the aggregate ClientMessage/ServerMessage and the enumerated module unions (incl. interaction messages), so any added/removed wire message type fails to compile until the contract is updated.

findings.summary: Plugin manifest validation lacks direct tests.
findings.evidence: No shared tests reference validatePluginManifest or resolvePluginPlatform outside the implementation files.
findings.recommendation: Add tests for required fields, invalid ids, semver warnings, contribution validation, platform inference, and frontend inference.

findings.summary: Shared production source still has lint warning debt.
findings.evidence: shared lint reports 107 warnings, including production warnings for non-null assertions, explicit any in correlation guards, unused facade imports, and import() type annotations.
findings.recommendation: Fix production-source warnings before test-only non-null assertions; use unknown-based guards in correlation.ts.

findings.summary: Local trust boundary is too broad for browser-reachable APIs.
findings.evidence: The server defaults to 0.0.0.0, enables global cors(), bypasses REST auth for localhost socket addresses, and treats any initial WebSocket auth message as authenticated.
findings.recommendation: Define explicit trust modes; restrict Origin/Host for local mode and require an unguessable local token or Bearer auth consistently for remote/LAN mode.
findings.verificationNote: CORS origin guard + mandatory WS auth added; still binds 0.0.0.0 when ZCLAUDIA_ALLOW_LAN=1.

findings.summary: File push route can copy arbitrary server-side file paths.
findings.evidence: POST /api/files/push accepts filePath from the request body; FileTransferService only checks that the path exists and is a regular file before copying it into the file store.
findings.recommendation: Restrict push sources to explicit allowed roots, require a privileged local token, or move arbitrary local file push behind an internal-only service API.

findings.summary: Stored file path resolution lacks path-safety validation.
findings.evidence: FileStore.getFilePath joins storageDir and fileId without rejecting absolute paths, parent traversal, or resolved paths outside the storage directory.
findings.recommendation: Validate file IDs as safe storage keys and ensure resolved paths remain inside storageDir before read/delete operations.

findings.summary: Schema migrations are applied outside a transaction.
findings.evidence: runMigrations executes migration SQL and then inserts the migration record as separate operations; applyMigrations has the same pattern.
findings.recommendation: Wrap each migration SQL execution and migration-record insert in a transaction, with rollback tests for mid-migration failures.

findings.summary: WebSocket router exceptions fall through to legacy handling.
findings.evidence: When router.route throws, server.ts logs the error and then calls handleClientMessage; the gateway message path follows the same pattern.
findings.recommendation: Only fall back on explicit route misses; route exceptions should emit a structured error and be covered by regression tests.
findings.verificationNote: routeOrFallback returns structured error on exception (sendRouteError) and only runs legacy fallback on route-miss (router-dispatch.ts:18-26).

findings.summary: GatewayClient centralizes too many networking responsibilities.
findings.evidence: gateway-client.ts is 1105 lines and combines connection lifecycle, handshake, registry, subscriptions, data publishing, stream routing, HTTP proxying, push notifications, reconnects, and offline queueing.
findings.recommendation: Split transport/handshake, registry, backend data, stream subscriptions, and HTTP proxy handling behind the existing command/query facade.
findings.verificationNote: HTTP-proxy handling (shouldStream/isUtf8Response/normalizeProxyRequestBody/handleHttpProxyRequest) extracted to gateway-http-proxy.ts with dedicated tests; gateway-client.ts 1225->1111 lines. Further CQE decomposition of registry/heartbeat/backend-data streaming deferred (high-risk stateful code).

findings.summary: Server infrastructure has substantial formatting and lint-warning debt.
findings.evidence: The batch scope has 279 files failing Prettier and 542 ESLint warnings; full server lint reports 1486 warnings.
findings.recommendation: Run the repository-wide mechanical format pass, then reduce production-source any and non-null assertions in security-sensitive server modules.
findings.verificationNote: Formatting resolved (format:check passes repo-wide); production lint-warning reduction still pending.

findings.summary: Architecture boundary rules miss direct SQL in common domain route variants.
findings.evidence: The architecture check flags routes.ts files, but direct SQL also appears in sessions/drafts-routes.ts and supervision/register.ts.
findings.recommendation: Expand the rule to cover domain route variants and registers, while allowing repository/storage files; move route-level checks behind repositories or services.

findings.summary: Agent default transitions can clear all defaults before the replacement write succeeds.
findings.evidence: Create/update routes and AgentProfileRepository.setDefault clear all defaults before creating/updating/setting the requested default; deletion already uses a transaction for default transfer.
findings.recommendation: Wrap clear-and-set/create/update default operations in repository/service transactions and add failure-injection tests.

findings.summary: Queued local PR conflict resolution does not enter queued state.
findings.evidence: When no execution slot is available, triggerConflictResolution updates only statusMessage and does not set executionState='queued' or pendingAction='resolve_conflict'.
findings.recommendation: Set queue fields consistently with review/merge paths and extend the no-slot test to assert executionState and pendingAction.
findings.verificationNote: No-slot branch now sets executionState=queued and pendingAction=resolve_conflict (local-pr/service.ts:760-764).

findings.summary: Claudia branch and session allocation is multi-step and partly non-atomic.
findings.evidence: The inline-message path allocates a branch, may set active branch state, inserts a session, and attaches the session to the branch across separate calls.
findings.recommendation: Introduce a transaction-scoped service for branch allocation plus session creation/attachment, with rollback/invariant tests for failed middle steps.
findings.verificationNote: Allocation moved into claudia-inline-session-allocation-service wrapped in db.transaction().

findings.summary: Conversation handlers bypass repository boundaries for session and message persistence.
findings.evidence: Conversation handlers issue direct SQL for project/session lookup, session creation, cancellation lookup, terminal project lookup, and steered message persistence.
findings.recommendation: Route conversation/session writes through cohesive session and message services, and add architecture checks for application/conversation handlers.
findings.verificationNote: Handlers route SQL through SessionRepository (no direct db.prepare); handler-level architecture check still pending.

findings.summary: LocalPRService is too broad for a git-mutating workflow service.
findings.evidence: local-pr/service.ts is 1196 lines and owns creation, review, verdict parsing, merge, revert, conflict resolution, queue processing, stale reset, cleanup, provider resolution, and session cleanup.
findings.recommendation: Split creation/refresh, review orchestration, merge/revert, conflict resolution, queue scheduler, and cleanup behind the existing API.

findings.summary: Server domain layer has heavy formatting and lint-warning debt.
findings.evidence: The domain/conversation/orchestration slice has 516 files failing Prettier and 764 ESLint warnings.
findings.recommendation: Run the repository-wide mechanical format pass, then reduce production warnings in large state-machine modules first.
findings.verificationNote: Formatting resolved; lint-warning reduction still pending.

findings.summary: Direct gateway secret is persisted in browser storage.
findings.evidence: gatewayStore partialize persists directGatewaySecret, while runtime gatewaySecret is intentionally excluded and old gatewaySecret keys are removed in migration.
findings.recommendation: Move direct gateway credentials to OS-backed secure storage where available, or persist only an opaque reference/session token with explicit fallback behavior.

findings.summary: Selection state is mirrored between projectStore and selectionStore.
findings.evidence: projectStore defines selectedProjectId, selectedSessionId, and dashboardViews, then synchronizes them with selectionStore through bidirectional subscriptions.
findings.recommendation: Make selectionStore the single writer for selection state and keep projectStore compatibility reads only during migration.

findings.summary: Protocol transport writes business stores directly.
findings.evidence: GatewayTransport imports sessionsStore, projectStore, and ownershipStore, then clears sessions/projects/ownership when registry items disappear.
findings.recommendation: Emit a typed registry-removal event from transport and perform store cleanup in facade runtime or facade sync code.
findings.verificationNote: Transport no longer imports stores; emits typed onBackendsRemoved event, store cleanup handled in facade sync (backend-data-sync.ts).

findings.summary: Sync services coordinate too many global stores.
findings.evidence: sessionSync and facade sync modules coordinate sessions, messages, projects, ownership, run state, recovery, terminal state, and toasts using several global stores and module-level maps/sets.
findings.recommendation: Introduce typed coordinator effects or reducers for reconciliation and add invariant tests for deletion, reconnect, snapshot replay, and content catch-up.

findings.summary: Dev embedded server lifecycle can leave orphan processes.
findings.evidence: Dev cleanup intentionally does not kill the spawned server to avoid StrictMode races, while PID registration failure is only logged.
findings.recommendation: Add a dev-process registry or lease with explicit cleanup on restart and tests for PID-registration failure and stale-process reuse.

findings.summary: Desktop data and connection layer has formatting and lint-warning debt.
findings.evidence: This batch scope has 200 files failing Prettier and 159 ESLint warnings across 252 evaluated files.
findings.recommendation: Run the repository-wide mechanical format pass, then reduce production warnings in stores, transport, embedded-server, and sync modules first.
findings.verificationNote: Formatting resolved; lint-warning reduction still pending.

findings.summary: Shared components layer has ambiguous ownership.
findings.evidence: Architecture check flags RightSidebarEmptyState importing features/git/store, while SettingsPanel in components imports many features/settings modules directly.
findings.recommendation: Define components/ as reusable shared UI only, move feature-aware containers into app/ or owning features, and expand architecture rules after ownership is explicit.

findings.summary: Several UI modules are too large and mix data, validation, state, and rendering.
findings.evidence: Large UI files include LlmProfileManager.tsx (1663 lines), AgentManager.tsx (1456), MessageInput.tsx (1306), McpServerSettings.tsx (1209), and MessageList.tsx (1165).
findings.recommendation: Split form reducers, validation/serialization helpers, data loaders, subcomponents, and keyboard/attachment handlers behind tested boundaries.

findings.summary: MessageInput stores attachments as full data URLs without a local size/count limit.
findings.evidence: addFileAsAttachment reads files with FileReader.readAsDataURL, stores them in component state and draft refs, and only downscales images; no local file size or count limit is visible.
findings.recommendation: Add shared attachment validation before reading files and prefer the streaming/upload path for larger files, with tests for oversized paste/select behavior.
findings.verificationNote: addFilesAsAttachments delegates to shared validateMessageAttachmentFiles (10MB / 8-file limits).

findings.summary: Components-only test partition is not healthy.
findings.evidence: vitest.components.config.ts failed with 4 failed files, 16 failed tests, and one unhandled mock error, while vitest.ui.config.ts passed 196 files and 2199 tests.
findings.recommendation: Repair stale component tests and shared mocks, or remove the components partition from recommended fast gates until it reflects current UI behavior.
findings.verificationNote: Components partition now green: 53 files / 696 tests pass (verified 2026-07-02).

findings.summary: UI lint signal is noisy and still has one hard error.
findings.evidence: UI feature ESLint reports 516 files, 1 error, and 521 warnings; warnings are dominated by non-null assertions and React hook rules.
findings.recommendation: Fix the baseline no-unused-expressions error, then reduce production React hook warnings and non-null assertions in large UI modules.
findings.verificationNote: Baseline no-unused-expressions error fixed; UI warning backlog remains.

findings.summary: UI formatting drift is large.
findings.evidence: Prettier reports 457 files in the UI feature scope as needing formatting.
findings.recommendation: Include UI files in the repository-wide mechanical format pass and keep format:check mandatory before UI refactors.

findings.summary: Project Node wrapper does not resolve the package manager.
findings.evidence: Root scripts invoke scripts/with-project-node.sh pnpm ..., but the wrapper directly execs the provided command when Node already matches .node-version; pnpm can still be absent from PATH.
findings.recommendation: Resolve pnpm through Corepack in scripts/with-project-node.sh or call corepack pnpm consistently from workspace scripts.

findings.summary: E2E setup depends on a sibling gateway repository.
findings.evidence: global-setup resolves GATEWAY_DIR to ../zclaudia-gateway, builds it with pnpm run build, and starts node dist/index.js from that external checkout.
findings.recommendation: Make the gateway an explicit fixture/artifact for E2E or split gateway-dependent tests into a separate integration profile.
findings.verificationNote: Gateway start gated behind TEST_MODES via createGatewayService; still builds/runs the ../zclaudia-gateway external checkout.

findings.summary: Local E2E can reuse any process on the expected ports.
findings.evidence: Outside CI, setup reuses a service when a TCP port is open; it does not verify health, protocol version, gateway secret, data directory, or service identity.
findings.recommendation: Replace raw port reuse with service-specific health and metadata checks, and fail early when an unexpected process owns the port.
findings.verificationNote: Port reuse now requires validateReusableServiceResponse (status/content-type/version/schema) before reuse.

findings.summary: Architecture boundary checker is too narrow for current server shapes.
findings.evidence: The checker scans only server/src/domains/**/routes.ts for raw SQL, while earlier batches found direct SQL in route-like and registration files not named exactly routes.ts.
findings.recommendation: Expand server scanning to route/register/handler file patterns and add tests for each supported shape.

findings.summary: Test-file helper builds shell commands from input.
findings.evidence: The helper interpolates the user-provided path into a find command string and later builds cd/npx/vitest shell strings; it also advertises ../zclaudia-gateway/src as a supported target.
findings.recommendation: Use spawnSync argument arrays, constrain accepted paths to the main repo by default, and make cross-repo testing an explicit mode.
findings.verificationNote: Rebuilt on spawnSync arg arrays (no shell interpolation); cross-repo target still advertised.

findings.summary: Deploy scripts use mutable package manager resolution.
findings.evidence: setup-server.sh prepares pnpm@latest when pnpm is missing, and deploy scripts fall back from pnpm install --frozen-lockfile to mutable pnpm install.
findings.recommendation: Use the repository packageManager version through Corepack and fail frozen install by default unless an explicit repair mode is requested.
findings.verificationNote: Uses repo packageManager via corepack prepare; mutable install gated behind ZCLAUDIA_DEPLOY_REPAIR_INSTALL=1, frozen by default.

findings.summary: Platform build scripts are large and duplicative.
findings.evidence: android.sh is 573 lines and macos.sh is 557 lines, with repeated environment setup, Node manager handling, package install/build, signing, cleanup, and artifact verification logic.
findings.recommendation: Extract shared bootstrap/version/signing/artifact helpers into smaller scripts or a typed build orchestrator, leaving thin platform wrappers.

findings.summary: E2E and scripts formatting/lint debt still reduces signal.
findings.evidence: Prettier reports 63 files in this scope as needing formatting, and ESLint reports 73 warnings across 84 evaluated JS/TS files.
findings.recommendation: Include E2E and scripts in the repository-wide mechanical format pass, then clean unused variables and type-import warnings in test helpers/specs.
findings.verificationNote: Formatting resolved; test-helper lint warnings remain.
